title: Christmas Pack 2025
description: This modpak is filled with warmth, cosiness and festive magic.
body:
![View in Game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3f16a7ce4414e9076a15fdf431a9ba8b4a0c5f9.png)🎄Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of this Christmas and New Year!🎁
🎅🏻This modpak is filled with warmth, cosiness and festive magic.🎅🏻
🎄Decorate your home with wreaths and trees and have a winter adventure with friends!🎄


What awaits you:

────୨ৎ────

❄️Snowy landscapes and soft winter light❄️

────୨ৎ────

🥂🌟New Year’s decorations, gifts and festive items🥂🌟

────୨ৎ────

🧣Atmospheric music and cozy vibe🧣

────୨ৎ────

🦌🛷Many fashions, creating a real holiday feeling!🦌🛷

────୨ৎ────

☃️Turn on the moodpak, light up the garlands and feel the Christmas miracle come to life right in Minecraft!☃️

────୨ৎ────

This modpack is made from other mods not related to me! But without them there would be no modpack!
